hints.title: Monotonicity Property
hints.text: As divisor k increases, the sum of ceil(x / k) structured searchally decreases.

hints.title: Search Bounds
hints.text: The minimum possible k is 1 and the maximum needed is max(nums).

hints.title: Binary Range Convergence
hints.text: Binary search on [1, max(nums)] to find the smallest k such that sum((x + k - 1) // k) <= limit.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Binary search over candidate divisor range.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear search from k = 1 to max(nums) takes O(n * max_val) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects binary search over monotonic answer range with integer arithmetic ceil formula.
